products.name: Browse AI
products.note: Web scraping automation; data extraction; monitoring; terms-of-service compliance risk

profile_text.body:
Browse AI is a no-code web scraping and monitoring platform that describes itself as the leading data scraper for users worldwide. The service allows individuals and businesses to extract data from websites, monitor pages for changes, and convert websites into APIs or live datasets without writing any code. Users point the tool at a webpage and the platform's AI structures the extracted data automatically, while also adapting to website changes so that scraping robots do not break when a site is updated.

The company's core product, also called Browse AI, sits in the automation and agents category and covers web scraping, data extraction, change monitoring, and integration via REST API connections. The platform includes features such as dynamic content capture, built-in bot evasion, proxy management, automatic retries, and rate limiting. Pre-built robots are available for specific sites and use cases, including scrapers for Best Buy product listings, Google Translate bulk translation, and various AI tool directories such as Futurepedia and Future Tools.

The held facts note a terms-of-service compliance risk associated with the product, which is a consideration relevant to any web scraping service whose robots interact with third-party websites under potentially varying legal and contractual conditions. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded for Browse AI in the current data.
